table.retrieve:
SELECT ReportData.code1,   
         ReportData.code2,   
         ReportData.value1,   
         ReportData.value2,   
         ReportData.value3,   
         ReportData.date1,   
         ReportData.name1,   
         ReportData.name2,   
         ReportData.name3  
    FROM ReportData   
WHERE code1 in (:ar_icatcode)
ORDER BY name1, name2, name3
table.sort: name1 A, name2 A, name3 A, value1 A

objects.name: compute_6
objects.expression: "Report Date:" + STRING(day( today() )) + '/' + STRING(month( today() )) + '/' + STRING(year( today() )) + SPACE(10) + SPACE(5) + "From :" +  STRING(day(ar_startdate )) + '/' + STRING(month(ar_startdate )) + '/' + STRING(year(ar_startdate )) + SPACE(10) + "To :" +  STRING(day(ar_enddate)) + '/' + STRING(month(ar_enddate)) + '/' + STRING(year(ar_enddate))

objects.name: t_2
objects.text: trim(case(month(date(left("@date1", 10))) when 1 then 'JAN.' when 2 then 'FEB.' when 3 then 'MAR.' when 4 then 'APR.' when 5 then 'MAY' when 6 then 'JUNE' when 7 then 'JULY' when 8 then 'AUG.' when 9 then 'SEPT.' when 10 then 'OCT.' when 11 then 'NOV.' else 'DEC.') + '~r~n' + Right(left("@date1", 10), 4))

props.values: sum(value2 for crosstab), sum(value3 for crosstab)
props.sourcenames: code1, code2, value1, value2, value3, date1, name1, name2, name3
